messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team — starting a concise quarterly patterns synthesis thread. Goal: one-line status updates for open postmortem actions, owners, timelines, and any fresh recurring incident patterns since the last review. Please keep replies short.
Dan Cho: Noted. I'll kick us off with the infra side.
Dan Cho: Recurring top causes from Feb–Mar: 1) autoscaler flaps from aggressive churn on model pools, 2) cache warm failures leading to cold token latencies, 3) occasional image-pull timeouts during deploys.
Liam O'Neill: From runtime: cache evictions + model KV cache lock contention cropped up 6x in last 8 weeks. Root cause looks like a config regression from quantization rollout.
Sophia Zhang: Observability note: our incident badge shows increasing incidents with the tag `service:batching` — up 35% q/q.
Rajiv Menon: Action item list (short):
- INFRA-412: Adjust autoscaler cooldowns + add jitter (owner: Dan, due: 2026-04-15)
- RUNTIME-221: Revert quant rollout on canary, add canary-specific KV cache metrics (owner: Liam, due: 2026-04-05)
- DEPLOY-89: Harden image-pull retry + make a preflight that fails CI on registry latency (owner: Emily, due: 2026-04-12)
Emily Rivera: Confirming DEPLOY-89. Blocker: registry team asked for our retry policy proposal by EOD Wed. I'll post a short PR.
Maya Patel: Quick ask: please add `labels: [incident-pattern, postmortem-action]` to each ticket so we can query them in the dashboard.
Dan Cho: Will do. Also adding a `mitigation` subtask to INFRA-412: automated temporary capacity bump for detected churn spikes.
Liam O'Neill: On RUNTIME-221 I'll instrument `kv_cache_hits`/`kv_lock_wait_ms` and add a Grafana panel. If we see lock wait > 50ms then auto-scale a cache shard.
Sophia Zhang: Timeline sanity check: can we close high-priority actions in 2–4 weeks? Which ones need longer?
Rajiv Menon: High priority: INFRA-412 and RUNTIME-221 target 2–3 weeks. DEPLOY-89 is 1 week once registry policy is agreed. Lower-priority runbook updates we can push to next sprint.
Emily Rivera: FYI ops-bot showing a spike yesterday: `image-pull-fail` alerts 11 events in 12h. I'm linking the alert -> https://monitoring.redwood.example/alerts/2111
ops-bot: [alert] image-pull-fail triggered 11 times in last 12h (top hosts: us-west-2-gpu-3).
Maya Patel: Good catch. Emily, can you add the alert link to DEPLOY-89 and tag `urgency:high`?
Emily Rivera: Done. DEPLOY-89 updated, PR for retry policy in draft.
Dan Cho: Operational mitigation proposal: add short-lived reserved instances for critical pools during major model rollouts to reduce autoscaler pressure. Can we evaluate cost impact?
Rajiv Menon: I'll run a 72h cost delta simulation and share numbers in INFRA-412 comments.
Liam O'Neill: On longer-term theme: we keep seeing configuration drift between canary and prod runtime flags (cache sizes, eviction thresholds). Action: `ops:consolidate-canary-configs` (owner: Sophia, due: 2026-04-20).
Sophia Zhang: Acknowledged. I'll make a small repo that templatizes runtime flags and add a CI gate that diff-checks canary vs prod.
Maya Patel: Runbooks: we need concise, one-screen playbooks for the top 3 recurring incidents. Who can author?
Dan Cho: I'll take autoscaler playbook (short steps to ramp capacity and rollback).
Liam O'Neill: I'll draft KV cache troubleshooting steps and a checklist to force-warm keys.
Emily Rivera: I'll update deploy/runbook steps for image-pull and registry fallback.
Maya Patel: Awesome. Please add a `doc:` prefix to the ticket title so we can track doc work.
Rajiv Menon: One metric ask: let's track recurrence rate (number of incidents with same tagged root cause) and MTTR by cause. We should have a baseline chart by next review.
Sophia Zhang: I'll add a recurrence_rate panel and a table of top 5 causes to the incidents dashboard.
Dan Cho: Small process improvement: postmortem follow-ups with >2 open actions get a weekly 15-min triage until closed. Can we trial that?
Emily Rivera: +1. Suggest Mondays 9:30 for a quick sync.
Maya Patel: OK — trial weekly triage starting next Monday. Dan to own calendar invite.
Dan Cho: Sent invite to participants and `#incidents` channel.
Liam O'Neill: Quick blocker: RUNTIME-221 needs a canary model snapshot for testing. Who owns snapshot exports?
Emily Rivera: I'll coordinate with model-ops to get a snapshot by Thu.
Rajiv Menon: Closing loop: please add owner commits and due dates to each ticket by EOD Friday so I can generate an executive summary for the ops review.
Maya Patel: Thank you all — concise and actionable. If you run into any blockers, reply here. We'll reconvene monthly for pattern trending. :spiral_calendar:
Sophia Zhang: Noted. Adding `next-review: 2026-05-15` to the agenda.
ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: incidents weekly triage (recurring) added to calendar.
Emily Rivera: Quick note — I'll attach a short incident timeline to each ticket to make reviews faster.
Dan Cho: Marking INFRA-412 as `in progress`.
Liam O'Neill: RUNTIME-221 PR for metrics instrumentation is up: https://gh.redwood/example/pull/432
Maya Patel: Great work, everyone. Short updates only after this thread if you need to escalate.
Sophia Zhang: :thumbsup:
